security_and_recovery.scheduler_scope: The real local composed test builds the actual local API/daemon composition with SQLite persistence, schedules a workflow, observes next runs, creates and cancels a workflow run, registers and delivers an event trigger, previews/starts/cancels a backfill, and exercises malformed non-text event and backfill identities with HTTP 400 responses. The new identity tests reject non-text scheduler IDs before AttributeError paths can become 500 responses.
security_and_recovery.provider_scope: RONIN_POSTGRES_TEST_DSN is absent and Docker does not provide a responsive daemon. No PostgreSQL operator, Docker worker or external notification provider was certified, and no mock was substituted.

limitations: The exact candidate sandbox has no .git metadata by design, so Git-dependent tests and repository status checks are not claimed from it; main checkout checks run separately.

A post-regeneration smoke selection created .ronin/cloud-studio inside the sandbox and correctly caused verify to reject extra files; that sandbox was discarded, cleanup was rerun, the candidate was regenerated from the same SHA, and final verify passed before the recorded scans.
The web regression used the clean checkout source at the candidate SHA because web node_modules is not part of the candidate archive; it is not presented as an exact-sandbox web result.
No hosted workflow or GitHub Actions evidence was used.
